scope: Four source IDs from the tracked #56 migration map; conformance fixture and sessions excluded

publicReadBaseline.primary12Definition: For each of the four original migration-map systems: primary current root, bundle.json and .timds-artifact.json; supplements include mirrors and every first-label stamp.

limitations: Point-in-time discovery only; recapture immediately before migration.
No source/session/publication/grant/credential/resource mutation, bulk artifact copy or cutover.
Local counts use filesystem metadata; full local file bytes were not hashed.
R2 was listed read-only using existing S3 credentials. Key/size matches do not prove byte equality; no R2 object bodies were downloaded.
R2 media for deleted Nacho was not enumerated because its former client mapping is absent.
The four-system #56 map is stale: Nacho source is absent with a deletion marker; only three active published systems remain outside test fixtures.
